INSERT INTO available_slot (start_time, end_time, is_reserved, created_by, created_date, version) SELECT DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL hours.hour_number HOUR), DATE_ADD(DATE_ADD(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00')), INTERVAL 1 DAY), INTERVAL (hours.hour_number + 1) HOUR), FALSE, 'SYSTEM', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), 0 FROM ( SELECT 9 AS hour_number UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 UNION ALL SELECT 20 ) AS hours;
